title: enhance-configure-logging-format
request: Can we make configure_logging include the level name and logger name in the log format, not just the message? I'd like the format to show "LEVEL LOGGER: message" so debugging is easier.
reference_diff:
--- a/src/mcp/server/mcpserver/utilities/logging.py
+++ b/src/mcp/server/mcpserver/utilities/logging.py
@@ -36,4 +36,4 @@
     if not handlers:  # pragma: no cover
         handlers.append(logging.StreamHandler())
 
-    logging.basicConfig(level=level, format="%(message)s", handlers=handlers)
+    logging.basicConfig(level=level, format="%(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s", handlers=handlers)
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/server/test_configure_logging.py
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+import logging
+
+import pytest
+
+from mcp.server.mcpserver.utilities.logging import configure_logging
+
+
+def test_configure_logging_sets_enhanced_formatter():
+    root = logging.getLogger()
+    # Ensure a clean state: remove existing handlers
+    original_handlers, original_level = list(root.handlers), root.level
+    root.handlers = []
+    try:
+        configure_logging(level="INFO")
+        assert root.handlers, "No handlers were added by configure_logging"
+        formatter = root.handlers[0].formatter
+        fmt_str = formatter._fmt if hasattr(formatter, "_fmt") else formatter.format
+        # The new format should contain levelname and name placeholders
+        assert "%(levelname)s" in fmt_str, "Formatter missing levelname placeholder"
+        assert "%(name)s" in fmt_str, "Formatter missing logger name placeholder"
+        assert "%(message)s" in fmt_str, "Formatter missing message placeholder"
+    finally:
+        # Restore original logging state to avoid side‑effects for other tests
+        root.handlers = original_handlers
+        root.setLevel(original_level)
